name: Veggie Ground "Dumpling" Smash Tacos with Carrot, Cucumber & Soy Dipping Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
¼ small bunch cilantro
½ English cucumber
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into a small bowl.

Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with soy sauce, vinegar, oil, and sugar. Stir to combine the dipping sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots; cut into thin matchsticks. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut cucumber into thin matchsticks. Add to the bowl with the carrot.

Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add a small handful of green onions to the bowl with the veggies, stir to combine and set aside. Place remaining green onions in another medium bowl.

Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the medium bowl with the green onions along with veggie ground, soy sauce, oil, white pepper, and crushed red pepper. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 clove garlic
1 ½ lb veggie ground, plant based
soy sauce
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp white pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the veggie ground mixture between them (about 1/3-cup per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the veggie ground mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, veggie ground-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the veggie ground is cooked through, about 3 minutes.

Flip tacos, veggie ground-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate, carefully fold in half to form tacos, and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Fill tacos with carrot, cucumber, and green onions. Serve with dipping sauce on the side and enjoy!
